milestones.title: MOVR Data Hub (MOVR 1.0)
milestones.text: MDA's registry across 7 diseases and 60 sites. Data collection ended in 2025; the data remains available for approved research.

milestones.title: MOVR 2.0 pilot
milestones.text: Families living with SMA, DMD and LGMD tested competing platforms side by side. Enrollment is closed.

milestones.title: Technology partner selected
milestones.text: MDA selected a technology partner for MOVR 2.0, informed by the pilot.

milestones.title: MOVR 2.0 recruitment opens
milestones.text: Recruitment for the full MOVR 2.0 launch opens. The disease communities included will be announced with it.
